mapper.select: SELECT id FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order WHERE id>#{after} AND sharing_status IN ('processing','pending') AND next_attempt_at<=#{at} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=#{at}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT w.id,w.settlement_batch_id batchId,COALESCE(w.rental_order_id,w.custom_order_id) orderId,w.custom_order_id IS NOT NULL custom,w.payment_channel_suborder_id suborderId,p.channel_mch_id platform,s.sub_mchid_snapshot merchant,s.channel_sub_transaction_id transactionId,w.channel_out_order_no shareNo,w.finish_out_order_no finishNo,w.platform_commission_amount_fen fee,w.factory_unlock_amount_fen unlockFen,w.commission_status commission,w.unfreeze_status unfreeze,w.commission_retry_count commissionRetries,w.unfreeze_retry_count unfreezeRetries,w.sharing_status status,w.exception_code exceptionCode,s.channel_unfrozen_at IS NOT NULL autoUnfrozen,w.next_attempt_at due,w.lease_until lease,w.version, COALESCE(w.commission_status='pending' AND w.channel_result_snapshot_json->>'$.outcome'='RETRYABLE' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(w.channel_result_snapshot_json,'$.channelNo'))='STRING',FALSE) retryHasChannelOrder FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order w JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.id=w.payment_channel_suborder_id JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=s.payment_order_id WHERE w.id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM rental_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM payment_channel_suborder WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM factory_settlement_batch WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_profit_sharing_order SET version=version+1,sharing_status='processing', commission_status=IF(#{finish},commission_status,'processing'),unfreeze_status=IF(#{finish},'processing',unfreeze_status), lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,30,#{at}),requested_at=COALESCE(requested_at,#{at}),updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{row.id} AND version=#{row.version} AND next_attempt_at<=#{at} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=#{at}) AND sharing_status IN ('pending','processing')

UPDATE wechat_profit_sharing_order SET commission_status=#{write.commission},unfreeze_status=#{write.unfreeze},sharing_status=#{write.status}, commission_retry_count=#{write.commissionRetries},unfreeze_retry_count=#{write.unfreezeRetries},actual_commission_amount_fen=COALESCE(#{write.actualFee},actual_commission_amount_fen),actual_unlock_amount_fen=COALESCE(#{write.actualUnlock},actual_unlock_amount_fen), channel_sharing_no=COALESCE(#{write.channelShare},channel_sharing_no),channel_finish_no=COALESCE(#{write.channelFinish},channel_finish_no),exception_code=#{write.exception},alert_status=IF(#{write.exception} IS NULL,IF(alert_status='open','resolved',alert_status),'open'), channel_result_snapshot_json=#{write.snapshot},lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=#{write.due},last_queried_at=IF(#{write.query},#{write.at},last_queried_at),success_at=IF(#{write.status}='success',#{write.at},NULL),failed_at=IF(#{write.status}='failed',#{write.at},NULL),version=version+1,updated_at=#{write.at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND sharing_status='processing'
UPDATE payment_channel_suborder SET channel_suborder_status='settled',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND channel_suborder_status='sharing'

UPDATE factory_settlement_detail d SET detail_status='settled',updated_at=#{at} WHERE settlement_batch_id=#{id} AND detail_status='included' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order w WHERE w.settlement_detail_id=d.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order w WHERE w.settlement_detail_id=d.id AND w.sharing_status<>'success')

UPDATE platform_commission_record c JOIN factory_settlement_detail d ON d.id=c.settlement_detail_id SET c.commission_status='confirmed',c.updated_at=#{at} WHERE d.settlement_batch_id=#{id} AND c.commission_status='pending' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order w WHERE w.settlement_detail_id=d.id AND w.commission_status NOT IN ('success','not_required'))

UPDATE factory_settlement_batch b JOIN factory_settlement_payment p ON p.settlement_batch_id=b.id AND p.payment_status IN ('success','failed') SET b.settlement_status=IF(p.payment_status='success','settled','failed'),b.settled_at=IF(p.payment_status='success',#{at},NULL),b.updated_at=#{at} WHERE b.id=#{id} AND b.settlement_status='processing'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM custom_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_order o WHERE o.id=#{id} AND o.order_status='completed' AND o.acceptance_status='accepted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_after_sale_request a WHERE a.active_order_guard=o.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refund_order r WHERE r.biz_order_type='custom_order' AND r.biz_order_id=o.id AND r.refund_status NOT IN ('success','cancelled')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_relation cr JOIN admin_case c ON c.id=cr.admin_case_id WHERE cr.relation_type='custom_order' AND cr.relation_id=o.id AND c.case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')))
